textRuns.value: Host medal share is the share of all medals at a Games won by the host country. Some of the decline over time is arithmetic. This dataset records 12 nations at Athens in 1896 and 207 at Rio in 2016, so any single country's share of the medals shrinks even when its results hold up. The gaps at 1916, 1940 and 1944 are the Games cancelled by the two world wars.
